objects.address_title: BiDiB accessory address. Windows without their own address are switched with the house.
setup.controllers_help: Devices found on the network. Assign a name and claim them.
setup.bus_diff: WLED length and object addresses appear here once a controller is selected.
setup.insert_help: If you soldered LEDs into the chain: first increase the LED count in WLED, then choose the position here (e.g. after LED 5 if three new ones sit between old LED 5 and 6). All object addresses from the next LED are incremented. You cannot create more LEDs than WLED is configured for.
setup.remove_help: If you unsoldered LEDs from the chain: choose the first removed LED and the count (e.g. from LED 6, three pieces, if old LEDs 6–8 are gone). All later object addresses are decremented. A smaller LED count in WLED does not block this – the difference is shown above so you can update several places in sequence.
setup.names_help: Names for single LEDs, RGB channels or ranges. In lists the name replaces “No. …” (e.g. LED 1 (street lamp)). Multiple color names appear separated by /. Inserting or removing on the bus moves the names with the LEDs. Numbers apply to the selected output (LED 1 is the first LED there).
ph.names:
LED1 = street lamp
3-7 = House3
12r = Halt
12g = Proceed
field.channel_title: Red, green or blue of this pixel, or all three
house.help: Choose windows with the dropdowns and “Add window”. Rows use global LED indices.
seq.help: A sequence switches the selected groups one after another. Between objects it waits a random pause between minimum and maximum (seconds). Switching off runs the order in reverse.
sig.help: Choose aspects with the dropdowns and “Add aspect”. Halt and proceed may share the same LED if red and green are split as RGB channels – then each color gets its own entry.
sp.help: WLED effect on the selected LEDs. Contiguous LEDs form a segment. Switching only turns it on and off. Already used LEDs are marked in the lists. WLED effects always act on the whole pixel; the RGB channel applies when turning off.
veh.help: Static model with light channels. One pixel has three RGB channels (R, G, B) – that lets you switch three individual LEDs independently. Beacon: either LEDs in sequence or the RGB channels in sequence (one WS2811 = three LEDs, R→G→B). Indicators of several vehicles run at slightly different speeds on purpose.
field.blink_title: Base; each vehicle differs a little
field.beacon_title: Duration until the next pixel or color channel
field.steps_title: Beacon only: whole pixels or the RGB pins of a WS2811 in sequence
veh.modes_help: Which channels are active in which switch state. “Default modes” creates Off, Lights, Hazards and Emergency depending on the channel types.
yaml.help: Structure of config.yaml as JSON. After “Apply” it is validated and loaded (changing the adapter may briefly drop the BiDiB connection).
